CI/CD Pipeline Steps

  1. actions/checkout@v4
  2. actions/setup-node@v4 → Node 24, npm cache
  3. npm ci → Install dependencies
  4. npm run test.coverage → Run Vitest coverage
  5. npm run build → Vite production bundle → dist/
  6. tar -czf *.tar.gz dist → Package artifact
  7. aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
  8. aws s3 sync dist s3://$AWS_S3_BUCKET --delete

Dev Server

  • Port: 5173 (Vite local) | 80 (Nginx container)
  • E2E base URL: http://localhost:5173
